body.message:
Dear fam living

I would like to raise a complaint regarding two issues I recently experienced.

First, on Thursday at 8:30 AM, two female cleaners arrived to clean and organize my personal belongings. They were denied entry due to a rule stating that access is only permitted from 11:00 AM. Accordingly, they left and returned again at 11:30 AM. However, they were once again denied entry, this time because an email from the holiday company was required. I would like to express my concern that this requirement was not clearly communicated to me earlier in the morning. If I had been properly informed at 8:30 AM, I could have arranged the necessary email in advance, instead of causing inconvenience and repeated delays for both myself and the service staff.

Second, yesterday I placed an order through Talabat, and I was informed that, under new management rules starting from that day, no deliveries are allowed to be brought up to the unit. Instead, residents must personally go down to collect their orders. I find this policy unreasonable and inconvenient. It is not practical, especially when ordering food or multiple items, to carry everything personally to the unit. I believe this rule is unfair and does not reflect a respectful or comfortable living environment.

I kindly request that these issues be reviewed and resolved. Otherwise, I may have to reconsider my stay, as I do not feel comfortable under such conditions.

Thank you for your attention and understanding.
